### Summary
- Root cause is not launch eligibility logic. In local mode, `selectedModeNotice` correctly disables launch when no ACP bridge or local runtime API is available.
- The bug is UX and state presentation: the disabled primary CTA still looks active because disabled styling only lowers opacity on the same copper primary button.
- Implement the smallest complete fix: keep the existing launch gating logic, but make disabled launch state visually, interactively, and accessibly unambiguous.

- Update [TaskWorkspace.tsx](/Users/zhangqilong/github代码仓库/longclaw-agent-os/electron/src/renderer/workspaces/TaskWorkspace.tsx) so the launch CTA uses a dedicated disabled-primary appearance instead of “primary button with opacity”.

  `Cmd/Ctrl+Enter` should not attempt submit when `launchDisabled` is true. It should either no-op or reuse the same disabled reason consistently. Default: reuse the same disabled reason.
